title: 加州总检察长：扎克伯格明知故犯，与烟草业如出一辙
speaker: Rob Bonta

segments.en: i was struck by your first answer mr attorney general as you imply that this is not only wrong doing but motivated premeditated this was on purpose
segments.zh: 总检察长先生，我对您的第一回答印象深刻，您暗示这不仅是不当行为，而是有预谋的，是故意的

segments.en: why would face book why would mark zucker berg aim to harm his clients his customers
segments.zh: 为什么Facebook，为什么马克·扎克伯格要伤害他的客户？

segments.en: well you could ask the same thing of the tobacco industry yeah you could ask the same thing of the opioid industry and the sackler family
segments.zh: 你可以问烟草业同样的问题，也可以问阿片类药物行业和萨克勒家族

segments.en: oh yeah this is the same same level stuff knowing about the harms having internal discussions and memos
segments.zh: 是的，这是同一级别的事情，知道危害，进行内部讨论和备忘录

segments.en: there was a feature called it was a filter a plastic surgery filter which changes your images using a plastic surgery type of technology
segments.zh: 有一个功能叫“整容滤镜”，用整容技术改变你的形象

segments.en: that shows what you look like after plastic surgery and it was known internally that this would harm the mental health of kids including especially young girls
segments.zh: 它展示整容后的样子，内部知道这会伤害孩子的心理健康，尤其是年轻女孩

segments.en: and his team warned him about it they raised the red flag he overruled them and said do it anyway
segments.zh: 他的团队警告他，举起了红旗，但他否决了，说照做

segments.en: he chose profit over the safety of children so it's the same thing with tobacco they knew about the harms and they visited that on the american public anyway
segments.zh: 他选择利润而非孩子的安全。烟草业也是如此，他们知道危害，却还是施加给美国公众

segments.en: so same with opioids they knew the addictive harmful impacts they visited on the american public anyway
segments.zh: 阿片类药物也一样，他们知道上瘾和有害影响，却还是施加给美国公众

segments.en: and this is not just the american public this is kids our kids our children the next generation
segments.zh: 这不仅仅是美国公众，这是孩子，我们的孩子，下一代

segments.en: as parents and teachers we have to be passionate about this and i am and so are the other attorneys general
segments.zh: 作为家长和老师，我们必须对此充满热情，我是，其他总检察长也是

segments.en: so yeah this is about knowing the harm doing it anyway doubling down on it and lying about it to the public it is very tobacco-like in that way
segments.zh: 所以，这关乎知道危害却照做，变本加厉，并对公众撒谎，这非常像烟草业
